data.name: Legends of Goodness
data.detailed_description:
Legends of Goodness is a fantasy strategy game that combines city building, resource management, large-scale real-time battles, and direct hero control into a single experience.

Following the collapse of humanity, the world has fallen under the rule of Whispera and the Reptilian Legion. Rebuild civilization, develop your cities, manage production chains, raise powerful armies, and liberate battlefields inspired by some of the most significant civilizations in world history from enemy occupation.
In Legends of Goodness, warfare is about more than issuing orders from above.

Command your armies from a classic real-time strategy perspective, deploy your units, and plan your attacks. Then, when you want to personally change the course of battle, take direct control of one of your heroes and join the fight on the front lines.

Engage your enemies in close combat, unleash attacks, and experience the battlefield through the eyes of your hero.

At any moment, return to strategic command and take control of your entire army once again.

Command your army. Become your hero. Enter the battle.

Reclaiming humanity’s lost lands requires more than a powerful army — it requires a strong civilization behind it.

Starting from a small settlement, expand your territory, construct buildings with different purposes, and lay the foundations of a thriving war economy.

From resource production to training your armies, every building in your city plays a role in your growth. Upgrade your structures to increase production capacity, unlock new possibilities, and prepare for the battles ahead.

But growth is about more than simply constructing more buildings.

Where you invest, which structures you choose to upgrade first, and how you balance your resources between your economy and your military will directly shape the strength you bring to the next battle.
Behind every great army stands a powerful economy that keeps it running.

Manage the production of gold, wood, and food. Assign your workers and establish a production system capable of supporting the needs of your growing civilization.

Decide how to distribute your resources between constructing new buildings, upgrading existing structures, and training warriors with different strengths to expand your military power.

But the lands you conquer will not remain safe forever. Reptilian armies may launch attacks to reclaim territories under your control. To defend what you have conquered, repel incoming assaults, and continue your advance, you must prepare your economy not only for growth, but also for building a powerful defensive army.

The investments you make in your economy today can become the foundation of a much larger army tomorrow. But spending all your resources on expansion may leave you vulnerable when the enemy reaches your gates. You decide when to grow, when to invest, and when to prepare for war.

Produce. Develop. Prepare. Because every resource you possess can ultimately become part of your strength on the battlefield.

data.short_description: Whispera and her Reptilian armies have taken control of the world. Manage your economy, construct buildings, train heroes, and build your army. Conquer territories to reclaim the world. Command your forces from above or take direct control of your hero and fight the Reptilians in third-person combat

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
